mapRecords.note: A map purchased for a small fee from a merchant outside the city gates.
A map given to you by Thoth Amon.  The sage has foreseen the coming of doom.  The first coming will be located on a small island near Westmoore. It will bring chaos and strife.
A map you drew to locate a secret entrance.  What lies beyond that point is unknown.
A map you drew to reflect the telepathic picture Thoth Amon sent to you.  It shows the location of the second coming of doom.
A map you bought for the outrageous fee of 950 gems.  It shows the location of a hidden treasure.
A map you drew.  It reveals the location where a dwarf war party entered the underworld.  They were attacked by a strange sorcerer that unleashed a deadly disease.
This map pinpoints the location of a group of dwarves that you have been commissioned to destroy.  The tunnel lies just east of where you first received this map.

This map shows the location of a portal to the nether world.  Two command words are scrawled on the map:  "Shirak" and  "Vistock".  These words will transport you one way or the other depending upon your location.

This map shows the location of a bastion that contains the portal to the nether planes.  Once inside, another map will reveal the exact location of the portal and the command words used to operate it.
A map showing the location of an unknown, special object.  The cave leads to a rock field to the south that has the object.
A map to Queen Selene's castle.
